items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 5232.11/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-06-09 was Rs 5232.11/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 1048.25-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).
